title: Gamified Health
tagline: Get paid to be healthy! Complete health quests and earn blockchain rewards!
description:
GamifiedHealth revolutionizes personal wellness by creating a blockchain-powered reward system for healthy behaviors. Users set personalized health goals (sleep improvement, step challenges, recovery tracking) and earn FLOW tokens automatically when they achieve their objectives.

Key Features:
• Automated Health Goal Verification: WHOOP fitness data → Flow blockchain → Instant rewards
• Family & Friend Sponsorship: Loved ones can sponsor health goals with transparent reward distribution
• Public Challenge Sponsorship: Community members can sponsor public health challenges
• Real-time Progress Tracking: Live updates on goal progress with blockchain transparency
• Instant Payouts: Smart contracts automatically distribute rewards when goals are met

The platform creates a supportive ecosystem where users get financially rewarded for healthy behaviors while building stronger connections with family, friends, and community sponsors who care about their wellness journey.
how_its_made:
Technical Architecture:

Frontend: Next.js 14 with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for a modern, responsive user experience

Blockchain Layer: Flow blockchain with Cadence smart contracts for automated goal verification and instant FLOW token payouts

Health Data Integration: WHOOP API with OAuth 2.0 for real-time fitness data collection and webhook-driven verification

Data Storage: Hypergraph Protocol for encrypted, local-first data sync with public/private knowledge graph separation

Key Technical Features:
• Flow Agent: Automated server-side verification system that processes WHOOP webhooks and executes smart contract logic
• Real-time Webhooks: Instant goal verification triggered by health data updates (sleep, workout, recovery, strain)
• Smart Contract Automation: Self-executing contracts that verify goals and distribute rewards without human intervention
• Multi-Sponsor Support: Family, friends, and public sponsors can fund health challenges with transparent blockchain tracking

The system demonstrates a production-ready automated health verification platform that can scale to thousands of users while maintaining data privacy and blockchain transparency.
